exposure: Gestational age at onset and delivery
outcome: Time taken for blood pressure to return to normal level
cohort: The study included 124 patients, comprising 63 with gestational hypertension and 61 with pre-eclampsia, who gave birth at Peking University People's Hospital between January and December 2013.
finding: The majority of patients with gestational hypertension or pre-eclampsia experienced normalization of blood pressure within 60 days of delivery, with hypertension severity, maternal serum albumin level, family history of hypertension, and gestational week at delivery influencing the time to recovery.
